name: Pierre Elliott Trudeau Foundation Doctoral Scholarship
amount: Up to CA$50,000/year for 3 years (min. CA$25,000) + CA$20,000/year research & travel allowance
dlText: 2027 competition: 6 Nov 2026, 16:00 ET (eligibility confirmation was due 2 Oct 2026)
tags: Must be enrolled in a PhD at a Canadian university
fields: Humanities and social sciences aligned with the Foundation's four themes (e.g. human rights and dignity, Canada and the world)
note: International students qualify only if already enrolled in a doctoral programme at a Canadian university; applicants had to request eligibility confirmation by 2 Oct 2026.

name: Ontario Trillium Scholarship (OTS)
host: Government of Ontario with Ontario universities
dlText: Universities nominate admitted international PhD applicants; internal dates vary by university
tags: Direct-entry PhD at an Ontario university
note: About 75 awards a year across Ontario; there is no separate application—apply to a PhD programme at a participating Ontario university and ask the department about OTS nomination.

name: NVIDIA Graduate Fellowship
amount: Up to US$60,000 + mandatory paid summer internship at NVIDIA
tags: Internship in summer before award year
fields: Computing research relevant to NVIDIA (AI, graphics, systems, robotics, etc.)
note: Applicants must have finished their first PhD year; winners are notified ~15 Jan and must do an in-person internship at an NVIDIA research office.

name: Apple Scholars in AI/ML PhD Fellowship
amount: PhD funding support + Apple internship opportunity + mentorship (check official page)
dlText: Nomination by invited universities; internal deadlines set by each university
note: You cannot apply directly: only universities invited by Apple can nominate students; ask your department whether it participates.

name: Microsoft Research Fellowship
dlText: 2026 call closed Nov 2025 (exact date not on an official page); next call not announced
nextText: Next call not yet announced — watch the official page
fields: Computing research challenges set by Microsoft Research
note: Replaced the old nomination-based PhD Fellowship: PhD students (with faculty approval) or faculty submit proposals to specific research challenges; your university must be in an eligible region.

name: Bloomberg Data Science Ph.D. Fellowship
amount: Full tuition + US$45,000 stipend + 14-week paid summer internship each year
fields: Machine learning, NLP, information retrieval and related data science
note: Recipients notified by 18 Dec 2026; fellows intern at Bloomberg each summer they hold the award.

name: Two Sigma PhD Fellowship
amount: Up to US$75,000/year for 2 years (paid to university) + one-time US$10,000 to the student
tags: Full-time PhD at a US university
fields: Applied mathematics, AI/computer science, physics, statistics
note: Open regardless of nationality but only to students at accredited US universities; students apply directly with a 750-word research proposal.

name: Jane Street Graduate Research Fellowship
country: Any (US, Canada, UK, Europe, Australia, NZ, Singapore universities)
amount: One year of tuition & fees + US$50,000 stipend
tags: 1+ year left in PhD (or starting Fall 2027)
fields: Electrical engineering & computer science, mathematics, physics, statistics
note: Students committed to starting a PhD in Fall 2027 can also apply; the university must be in one of the listed regions.

name: Hertz Fellowship
amount: Up to 5 years: stipend + full tuition equivalent
fields: Applied physical and biological sciences, mathematics, engineering
note: Permanent residents also qualify (proof required); not open to international students. Finalists named Feb 2027, awards announced May 2027.

name: NSF Graduate Research Fellowship Program (GRFP)
amount: ~US$159,000 per fellowship (3 years of support usable over 5 years)
dlText: 19–23 Oct 2026, 20:00 ET depending on field (CS/engineering-adjacent: 20 Oct) — closed
tags: First year of first graduate degree
fields: STEM and STEM education, psychology and social sciences
note: Not open to international students; permanent residents qualify. Solicitation NSF 26-526 offers ~1,500 awards.

name: AAUW International Fellowships
amount: US$25,000 (doctorate) / US$20,000 (master's), paid in two instalments

eligibility.note: Women who are not US citizens or permanent residents (check the official eligibility page)

note: For women who are not US citizens or permanent residents studying full-time in the US; awards announced ~Mar 2027.
